# spec lint

=== step 1: dashcrew "help" "spec" "lint"
exit: 0
stdout:
| Check spec files: front matter, IDs (AC-n, D-n, C-n) and the open questions of an approved spec.
| With --against, compare with a git ref: a vanished, renumbered or reused ID, and an approved file changed
| without a rev increase. Exits 1 on any problem. Writes nothing.
| 
| Usage: dashcrew spec lint [<path>] [arguments]
| -h, --help       Print this usage information.
| -p, --project    Project root holding .ai/project.yaml; finds the clone when no <path> is given.
|                  (defaults to ".")
|     --clone      Knowledge clone whose specs/ to check when no <path> is given; defaults to the profile's.
|     --against    Git ref to compare each file with, such as origin/main.
| 
| Run "dashcrew help" to see global options.
stderr: (empty)
files: (unchanged)
